thread:
Aisha: hi all, Aisha here. first week and my first on-call rotation starts tomorrow. a couple of quick setup snags and process q's.
Tom: welcome! short and sweet works. what do you need?
Aisha: 1) can't finish PD SSO pair because the MFA code never accepts. i've tried app & sms.
helpdesk-it: sometimes our Okta session needs a second device approval. Log out of all browsers, then retry. If sms codes fail, request an unlock ticket at https://internal.redwood/helpdesk and mention 'PD SSO MFA stuck'.
Aisha: thanks. 2) my PagerDuty schedule shows the correct shift, but the Slack PD bot didn't DM me when i tested.
rachel: check Slack app permissions: Apps -> PagerDuty -> allowed to send direct messages. also confirm you have the PD user mapping set to your corporate email.
Aisha: i tested PD web -> "send test notification" and it shows delivered. maybe Slack is blocking DMs from apps.
Tom: also verify in PD integrations that the Slack workspace is enabled for the service and that "notify on-call users" is checked.
Aisha: 3) where's the fast triage checklist? i want something i can memorize for the first few pages.
rachel: we keep a 6-step starter in the ops playbook: 1) ack in PD, 2) post to #incidents/<service>, 3) check runbook top-level steps, 4) look at recent deploys and CI, 5) gather logs and metrics, 6) escalate to EM at 15m if not mitigated.
Aisha: is there a recommended set of CLI snippets to copy into my notes?
rachel: common ones: `kubectl -n svc get pods`, `stern service-name`, `curl -s https://runbooks.redwood/service/latest | sed -n '1,120p'`, `pd incidents list --service service-name`. stash them in your oncall-notes doc.
Aisha: 4) runbook ownership question: i saw two people listed as owners. who approves runbook edits?
Tom: owner listed in the runbook header should review. if multiple owners, ping both and create a small MR with `runbook:` prefix. for urgent fixes, we accept immediate edits with follow-up review.
Aisha: 5) can i shadow someone during my first real page?
sre-training: yes 12shadowing enabled. we'll tag your PD user with `shadow:true` and your buddy will appear on the incident. i've assigned @Tom as your buddy for the first three pages.
Aisha: awesome. final: what's expected for post-incident notes for a Sev3?
rachel: Sev3: short incident summary in channel within 24h and a one-paragraph RCA in the incident doc. only Sev2+ needs a full postmortem with timelines and blameless analysis. use the template at https://confluence/redwood/pm-templates/postmortem.
Aisha: perfect. i'll try a simulated page at 02:30 UTC tomorrow to test mobile + slack DM. ok to run that?
Tom: fine. i'll be online and will watch. ping here when you run it.
oncall-bot: Reminder: new oncall checklist not complete? Visit https://internal.redwood/oncall-checklist to finish mandatory steps.
Aisha: thanks everyone, logging a helpdesk ticket for MFA now. i'll report back after the sim.
